# Operator CLI

<!-- Generated by `node lib/ops/cli.ts docs`; do not edit by hand. -->

All commands are dry runs unless `--execute` is passed. `--reason` and `--env` are
always required; `--env production` also requires `--confirm-production`. Set
`LAFIYA_OPERATOR_ACCESS_TOKEN` to your own Supabase session token (admin role, MFA).

## `outbox:requeue`

Reset an outbox row so the dispatcher redelivers it.

| Flag   | Description          |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| `--id` | Outbox row id (uuid) |

## `rate-limit:reset`

Delete a rate-limit key so the caller is unblocked.

| Flag    | Description                                         |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `--key` | Rate-limit key, e.g. attestation-lookup:203.0.113.7 |

## `flag:set`

Enable or disable a feature flag / kill switch.

| Flag        | Description                 |
| ----------- | --------------------------- |
| `--key`     | Flag key from FLAG_REGISTRY |
| `--enabled` | true or false               |
